title: A more visual SubTake
message: Choose your appearance, cursor, and webcam position at a glance.

scenes.title: Choose your appearance
scenes.purpose: Show the Light, Dark, and System choices alongside grouped automatic-zoom settings.
scenes.caption: Your appearance. Your motion.
scenes.narration: Choose an appearance and a motion preset that fit your video.

scenes.title: Pick a cursor visually
scenes.purpose: Show the actual Tahoe, macOS, Windows, Dot, and Minimal thumbnail choices.
scenes.caption: See the cursor before choosing it.
scenes.narration: Find the cursor style you want from visual thumbnails.

scenes.title: Position your webcam
scenes.purpose: Show the nine-position grid and the Custom position control visible in the screenshot.
scenes.caption: Place your webcam with a visual grid.
scenes.narration: Choose a webcam position from the grid, or fine-tune a custom position.
